# Codex CLI

Setup id: `codex` (`python install.py --client codex`). Tier: hooks: the brief, write checks and checkpoint reminder arrive by hook.

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Instructions | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` (marker-block) |
| Skills | `~/.agents/skills` (installed once, in the first one not already shared) |
| Legacy skills | `~/.codex/skills` (refreshed in place when present, never created) |
| Hooks | `~/.codex/hooks.json`, scripts in `~/.codex/hooks/vault`; Stop answers with JSON `{"decision": "block", "reason": ...}` on exit 0, which continues the turn |
| Checkpoint | transcript (`--source codex --session <id> --transcript <path>`) |
| Detected by | `~/.codex`, `codex` on PATH, `$CODEX_HOME` |
| Verified version | not yet fixture-verified on a named release |

The line this agent gets after the shared rules:

> Codex CLI: once its hooks are trusted in `/hooks`, the startup brief and checkpoint reminder arrive by hook; otherwise run `vaultctl.py session-brief` once. Checkpoint on this session's rollout in `~/.codex/sessions/`, model from its `turn_context.model`.

User skills are $HOME/.agents/skills per developers.openai.com/codex/skills (checked 2026-10-18); earlier releases installed ~/.codex/skills, which is refreshed in place when present and never created. Hooks per developers.openai.com/codex/hooks (checked 2026-10-18): ~/.codex/hooks.json, enabled by default ([features].hooks), each new hook needs trust in /hooks; SessionStart plain stdout becomes developer context, PostToolUse apply_patch carries the patch in tool_input.command, Stop needs JSON {decision: block} on exit 0 and turns the reason into a continuation prompt; the payload carries model.

Vendor documentation: https://github.com/openai/codex#installing-and-running-codex-cli
